text.p: These are the leading stories in the Turkish press on Thursday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Islamist MP Hasan Huseyin Ceylan says no one will be able to enforce a ban that the military wants to impose on Islamic dress.
- President Suleyman Demirel says he may come back into party politics if Turkey's conditions require it.
- A reality show programme showing sexual harrassment by a doctor broke a rating record.
- Turkey's economic performance falls on Euromoney list.
- Moslem sects trying to find a way round military-inspired crack down on them.
- The ruling Islamist Welfare Party is infiltrating supporters into the state bureaucracy.
- Tourism ministry steps up a $17 million campaign to promote Anatolia. The campaign will last until year 2000.
- HaleBopp comet will be seen for a month from Turkey.
